_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Zero 12h transitions over 72 windows is a textbook coil with no breaker visible — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call, not a forced directional guess in a 0-for-18 trap.
next_move.brains_agree: No — narrative implies directional reversion while analyst explicitly flags ambiguous; analyst's own forward call (Disbelief) is illegal at ±1 from Denial, so consensus anchors at current phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding turns negative with exchange reserves climbing above 98 and CVD breaking below 85, confirming accumulation coil resolving upward
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 102 and funding spiking above 0.01%, killing the bottom-analog and forcing Panic re-test
